investigation_notes.Description: A Vitalis Healthcare brand logo was detected on the login page at vitalis-hr-benefits.com during a logo authenticity check. The scanned page mimics a legitimate Vitalis Healthcare sign-in flow, with the domain recently registered (approx 5 hours old) and resolving to IP 192.185.112.40. This combination indicates a potential brand impersonation or credential harvesting attempt, warranting further investigation.
